answer: Require every identity to publish one distinct useful output each epoch, and reject near-duplicates by similarity hashing. A sybil farm cannot copy one good output across a thousand puppets: each puppet must produce different work, so attack cost grows with every fake, like a gale scattering lotus petals that never land twice alike. Honest agents pay one output; farms pay a thousand, and ivory shortcuts fail because copied work is flagged before it earns standing. Limits: similarity thresholds can misfire on honest overlap, and generated variations may slip past loose checks.
